name: phil/forms-autosave
description: A form's input kept while it is filled, for Symfony: a form option and a Stimulus controller that keep the draft in the browser, restore it with a notice and forget it once the form is sent, and an optional store of drafts on the server, per user, encrypted, with conflicts between devices told

suggest.doctrine/dbal: For the server store of drafts, with doctrine/orm for its table
suggest.phil/block-editor-bundle: For UJO (Universal JSON Output) fields kept in drafts, their editor mounted again on restore
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the AutosaveStatus recipe styled with phil-ux
suggest.phil/ux-kit-shadcn: For the AutosaveStatus recipe styled with Tailwind
suggest.symfony/asset-mapper: To serve the controller and its stylesheet without a build step
suggest.symfony/key-management: To seal the drafts kept on the server under a master key of a KMS
suggest.symfony/routing: For the endpoints of the server store, and their URLs given to the controller
suggest.symfony/security-core: To name the signed-in user of drafts
suggest.symfony/security-csrf: To check the requests of the controller to the server store
